anveshanGuide.title: Advisory guide
anveshanGuide.intro: Write an advisory for any {{count}} of your farmer queries with information you can back up. Here is how it works and what makes an advisory useful to farmers.
anveshanGuide.step1: Pick a query from "Farmers' Queries". Queries with a submitted advisory show a green "Advisory given" badge.
anveshanGuide.step2: Read the query again and write your advisory in "Draft Advisory".
anveshanGuide.step3: Add anything reviewers should know in "Remarks" (optional).
anveshanGuide.step4: Add at least one source: choose the type, enter the source name, paste the link and page numbers, then press + (or Enter).
anveshanGuide.step5: Press Submit. If anything is missing, a message appears under that field; fix it and press Submit again, then confirm.
anveshanGuide.rulesTitle: Checks before your advisory is accepted
anveshanGuide.ruleUnlock: Advisories unlock only after your question, crop, weed, pest and disease submissions are complete.
anveshanGuide.ruleEligible: Only the queries listed here (your earliest submissions) can receive an advisory.
anveshanGuide.ruleAnswerLength: The advisory is required and must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. The counter above the advisory box turns green once you pass {{min}}.
anveshanGuide.ruleRemarks: Remarks are optional, up to {{max}} characters.
anveshanGuide.ruleSourceCount: At least 1 source is required, and you can add up to {{max}}.
anveshanGuide.ruleSourceFields: Every source needs a type (Hyper Local, State, Central or Other), a name and a link.
anveshanGuide.ruleUrl: Links must be complete public web addresses starting with http:// or https://, for example https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/…
anveshanGuide.rulePdf: For PDF links, page numbers are required so reviewers can find the exact lines.
anveshanGuide.rulePages: Page numbers must be whole numbers from 1, separated by commas, for example 4 or 12,13.
anveshanGuide.ruleDuplicate: The same link with the same type and pages cannot be added twice.
anveshanGuide.ruleOnce: Each query can receive one advisory. Advisories cannot be edited after submitting.
anveshanGuide.ruleEvaluation: The quality of every submitted advisory is carefully reviewed during evaluation.
anveshanGuide.good1: Address the exact query: the crop, the problem and the stage the farmer describes.
anveshanGuide.good2: Start with the likely cause, then give clear steps the farmer can follow in order.
anveshanGuide.good3: Be specific: product or practice name, dose per litre or per acre, timing, interval and how many times.
anveshanGuide.goodLength: Use the {{min}}+ characters to explain properly: the cause, step-by-step actions, doses and precautions. Do not pad with repeated text.
anveshanGuide.good4: Prefer safe and low-cost options first (cultural, biological), then chemical control if needed, with safety precautions.
anveshanGuide.good5: Match the local context: state, season and variety. Mention when a local expert or KVK should be consulted.
anveshanGuide.good6: Use simple language, short sentences and the same language as the question where possible.
anveshanGuide.good7: Only write what your sources support. Do not guess doses or product names.
anveshanGuide.typeHyperLocalEx: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), district agriculture office or local research station advisories, or similar local sources.
anveshanGuide.typeStateEx: State agricultural university package of practices or state agriculture department portals, or similar state sources.
anveshanGuide.typeCentralEx: ICAR institutes, Ministry of Agriculture, CIB&RC approved uses or national crop portals, or similar central sources.
anveshanGuide.typeOtherEx: Peer-reviewed journals, FAO or similar recognised research bodies.
anveshanGuide.src1: Use official or research websites, for example sites ending in .gov.in, .nic.in, .ac.in, .res.in or icar.org.in, or similar.
anveshanGuide.src2: Link to the exact page or document, not a home page, and give the page numbers for PDFs.
anveshanGuide.src3: Name the source clearly, for example "KAU Package of Practices 2016".
anveshanGuide.src4: Prefer recent, region-specific recommendations. Open the link once to make sure it works.
anveshanGuide.avoid1: Social media posts, videos, forums, shopping sites or AI chat output as sources.
anveshanGuide.avoid2: Copying text without checking it fits the farmer’s crop and region.
anveshanGuide.avoid3: Banned or unapproved chemicals, or doses without units.
anveshanGuide.avoid4: Personal details, phone numbers or advertising in the advisory.
